adapted.sourcePolicy: one-for-one Octane probes after permitted import-root and ReactNode→OctaneNode transformations

permittedTransformations.rule: react-transition-group package and subpath imports become relative ../src/index.ts and ../src/types.ts imports; multiple type subpath imports may consolidate into one ../src/types.ts import
ReactNode becomes OctaneNode and the react type import becomes an octane type import
TypeScript printer output must remain structurally identical after the permitted import and node-type rewrites

divergences.rationale: @types/react-transition-group 4.4.x does not export ReplaceTransition; the Octane package still ships ReplaceTransition and exports.test.ts covers the runtime export outside these one-for-one type probes.
